editorial_rule: Seller claims are not scientific substantiation. Do not publish commerce until all required gate proofs verified.

sources.name: Hypnotic suggestibility and rubber hand illusion
Mind and affiliate canonical GitHub Issue #171

claims.claim: 1998 researchers reported artificial-hand ownership under coordinated sensory inputs
claims.decision: Publish with original paradigm limits; not universal

claims.claim: Original authors framed vision, touch and proprioception as interacting
claims.decision: Do not claim all participants responded

claims.claim: 2022 journal papers investigate suggestibility and expectation as alternative/contributing accounts
claims.decision: Represent disagreement and measures

claims.claim: A 2022 analysis reports sensory correspondence dominated hypnotisability and measured expectation
claims.decision: Do not universalize to all illusions

claims.claim: Archive tracks signed testimony, operator influence and historical failed cases
claims.decision: Historic case file, not treatment validation

claims.claim: Seller lists 12 levels and 48 MP3 audio files
claims.decision: Can describe with seller attribution

claims.claim: Seller lists quick-start manual, support, audio guides, bonuses and training call
claims.decision: Recheck before any release

claims.claim: Seller displayed $87.99 Premium on 2026-11-13
claims.decision: Reverify exact checkout taxes/region and upsells

claims.claim: Merchant advertises one-year guarantee
claims.decision: No guarantee of refund processing by FV

claims.claim: Claim that 12 min audio equals one hour meditation
claims.decision: Exclude as FV assertion

claims.claim: Merchant advertises mood, relaxation and physical health outcomes
claims.decision: No product-benefit assertion

claims.claim: Merchant presents brainwave entrainment as proven mechanism
claims.decision: Do not extrapolate general audio science

claims.claim: Seller advertises 200+ MP3s
claims.decision: Separate from Zen12; not personal test

claims.claim: Seller advertises guaranteed results or refund
claims.decision: Do not copy into FV promises

claims.claim: Seller offers a product named Focus Shot
claims.decision: No efficacy assertion

claims.claim: Public site describes publisher program and issued special links
claims.decision: No live earnings link

claims.claim: Final Vestige-specific acceptance, account and channel permissions
claims.decision: Founder/Commerce must provide authenticated evidence

claims.claim: Public generic payout descriptions differ from account-specific contract
claims.decision: Do not forecast or assert rates

claims.claim: Issued FV-specific Zen12 tracking link
claims.decision: Withhold; no redirect or link cloaking

claims.claim: Exact publisher-approved product creatives or swipe permission
claims.decision: No copying promotional language

claims.claim: Material commission relationship must be clear conspicuous near recommendation/link
claims.decision: Test disclosure in same viewport as CTA

claims.claim: Health claims need competent reliable scientific substantiation as appropriate
claims.decision: Product-specific proof or omit

claims.claim: Existing live free 52-page Seven Day Focus Fieldbook uses established signup
claims.decision: Preserve Jetpack path

claims.claim: Journal currently says 66 results, issue #171 baseline was 61
claims.decision: No CMS edit

claims.claim: A relevant rights-cleared, currently deliverable FV Mind SKU with functioning paid checkout
claims.decision: No paid owned CTA

claims.claim: Merchant confirms a paid order or settled affiliate conversion attributable to FV
claims.decision: No conversion assertion

claims.claim: Confirmed gross less refunds, merchant fees and actual costs
claims.decision: No zero substitute; finance reconciliation

claims.claim: Three actual posted immutable Mind-topic asset_id and allowed mobile destination
claims.decision: Praxxis and Grok own exact mapping

claims.claim: Accessible 42-second script/poster/captions treatment
claims.decision: No claim of playable encoded video

claims.claim: Text+video increases net realized revenue relative to text
claims.decision: Randomize by eligible sessions and verify orders
